# inner automorphism　`def.inner-automorphism`
English entry · root `../`
[in graph](../#n=def.inner-automorphism)　·　[Chinese page (authoritative)](./def.inner-automorphism.md)

form a group under composition, and $\operatorname{Inn}(G) \cong G/Z(G)$, $\operatorname{Inn}(G) \trianglelefteq \operatorname{Aut}(G)$.

## Notes · **draft**
⭐ Inner automorphisms are exactly the image of the **conjugation action** of $G$ on itself: $c_g$ is the map $x \mapsto g \cdot x$ (conjugation).

⭐ The inner automorphism group is trivial $\iff$ $G$ is abelian; then $\operatorname{Inn}(G) = \{\mathrm{id}\}$ and $\operatorname{Out}(G) = \operatorname{Aut}(G)$.
